offering_description.value: Wholesale insurance broker and managing general underwriter that places hard-to-place specialty and excess and surplus commercial insurance for businesses. It sells through retail insurance agencies and earns commissions and fees by placing coverage with insurers and through its own binding authority programs.

primary_products.value: commercial liability policies; property policies; professional liability policies; program insurance

primary_services.value: wholesale brokerage; underwriting management; program administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: retail insurance agencies and brokers placing coverage for commercial businesses

end_markets.value: construction; real estate; professional services; healthcare; transportation; energy

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions on specialty policies placed with insurers; service fees: underwriting management and program administration fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places risk between retail agencies and insurance carriers, taking commissions from carriers and agencies; service provider: manages underwriting and program administration for carriers and programs

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide across US states, with smaller operations in the UK and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: wholesale brokerage, binding authority programs, underwriting management and specialty benefits

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: retail insurance agencies that submit business to its wholesale brokers; own locations: offices across US cities and abroad serving agencies directly

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed insurance brokering and underwriting regulated by state insurance departments and UK regulators

notes: International footprint and exact scope of some operations are uncertain.
